name: PT Asuransi Bina Dana Arta Tbk
summary: PT Asuransi Bina Dana Arta Tbk operates as a general insurance company in Indonesia. The company offers car, motor vehicles, fire, personal accident and health, group health, freight, home, property, critical illness, engineering, marine cargo, miscellaneous, travel, and other insurance products. It also provides motor vehicle repair services. PT Asuransi Bina Dana Arta Tbk was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Asuransi Bina Dana Arta Tbk is a subsidiary of Oona Insurance Pte. Ltd.
